items.statement: The investigation validates selected noncovalent minima for each named X-F pair and records search/validation context before using energies.
items.expected: Each of 2g-F, 3g-F, 2w-F and 3w-F has an identifiable validated structure or an explicitly reported bounded failure; monomer and complex charge/multiplicity are consistent.

items.statement: Interaction energies are assembled as complex energy minus the separately computed energies of the named monomer and catalyst.
items.expected: The report shows this arithmetic for all four named pairs and uses one consistent energy convention and unit.

items.statement: The four catalyst interaction energies are quantitatively reported for the named pairs.
items.expected: The submitted four values correspond to 2g-F, 3g-F, 2w-F and 3w-F in kcal/mol.
